title: Datadog Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Observability Pipelines
summary: See metrics from all of your apps, tools & services in one place with Datadog's cloud monitoring as a service solution. Try it for free.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK** –[Datadog](https://www.datadoghq.com/) , Inc. (NASDAQ: DDOG), the leading AI-powered observability and security platform, today announced it has been named a Leader in the *Gartner Magic Quadrant for Observability Pipelines, 2026* . This is Datadog’s second placement as a Leader in Gartner research this year, following the[2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Observability Platforms](https://www.datadoghq.com/about/latest-news/press-releases/datadog-named-a-leader-in-the-2026-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-observability-platforms/) .


“Telemetry keeps growing across applications, infrastructure and AI workloads, and teams need to control costs and choose the right destination for their data without losing the insights they rely on. Datadog Observability Pipelines gives Security and DevOps one control point for the same telemetry, and connects it to the rest of Datadog so teams can detect and investigate with precision,” said Yanbing Li, Chief Product Officer at Datadog. “To us, this recognition reflects how Datadog helps Observability and Security teams aggregate, standardize and govern their telemetry while keeping control of costs.”


Customer feedback is vital to Datadog’s product innovation. Recent Gartner® Peer Insights™ quotes include:


“Datadog has provided excellent visibility across our infrastructure and cloud environment, the platform is easy to deploy, integrates well with other systems, and helps us identify and resolve issues quickly; the dashboards, alerting and observability capabilities have become an important part of our operational monitoring strategy,” said an[IT Manager at a finance company](https://www.gartner.com/reviews/market/telemetry-pipelines/vendor/datadog/product/datadog-534048731/review/view/6892068) .


“Exceptional, I completely enjoy the central monitoring platform for all monitoring, logging and traces about both application and infra. Added with the powerful visualization tools it provides, it is a gamechanger for custom dashboards and compliance monitoring,” said an[Engineer at a finance company](https://www.gartner.com/reviews/market/telemetry-pipelines/vendor/datadog/product/datadog-534048731/review/view/6887972) .


We feel Datadog’s Observability Pipelines product helps customers like[Rakuten Viber](https://www.datadoghq.com/case-studies/rakuten-viber/) :


- **Aggregate and Standardize:** Collect telemetry from agents, collectors, and open frameworks like OpenTelemetry, and remap it to the schema teams already work in, including OCSF for security data.
- **Transform and Govern:** Parse, enrich and redact sensitive fields before data leaves the team’s network, with rules applied consistently across every source.
- **Control Costs and Volume:** Filter noise, sample high-volume sources and archive to lower-cost storage, so teams pay for only the data they use.
- **Achieve Flexibility:** Route the same stream to Datadog, a SIEM and internal archives at once, and change where data lands without re-instrumentation.


The full report is now available for download[here](https://www.datadoghq.com/resources/gartner-magic-quadrant-observability-pipelines-2026/) .

#### About Datadog


Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence.
